cards.stem: How many colonies are shown casting affirmative votes in the document view described?
cards.quote: The document seen here shows the vote on the Lee Resolution — the affirmative votes of 12 colonies are listed at the right.
cards.hint: Count the affirmative votes listed at the right.

cards.stem: Who introduced the resolution proposing independence for the American colonies?
cards.quote: On June 7, 1776, Richard Henry Lee introduced a resolution
cards.hint: Look for the Virginia delegate backed by his colony convention.

cards.stem: Which was listed as one of the three parts of the Lee Resolution?
cards.quote: The Lee Resolution contained three parts: a declaration of independence, a call to form foreign alliances, and "a plan for confederation."
cards.hint: Check the list that includes foreign alliances and confederation.

cards.stem: What did Congress create on June 11, 1776 in response to the Lee Resolution?
cards.quote: On June 11, 1776, the Congress appointed three concurrent committees in response to the Lee Resolution
cards.hint: Note the groups appointed to handle declaration and alliances.
